key.name: default-timeout-ms
key.summary: Default popup timeout (ms)

key.name: low-urgency-timeout-ms
key.summary: Low-urgency popup timeout (ms)

key.name: min-timeout-ms
key.summary: Floor on display time (ms); 0 = respect each notification's own timeout

key.name: max-timeout-ms
key.summary: Hard cap on display time (ms); 0 = respect each notification's own timeout

key.name: fade-ms
key.summary: Fade in/out duration (ms); 0 disables

key.name: max-stack
key.summary: Max simultaneous popups

key.name: width-px
key.summary: Absolute popup width (px); 0 = derive from geometry

key.name: width-height-fraction
key.summary: Popup width as a fraction of monitor height

key.name: max-width-fraction
key.summary: Cap on popup width as a fraction of monitor width

key.name: gap-px
key.summary: Vertical gap between popups (px)

key.name: margin-px
key.summary: Margin from the screen corner (px)

key.name: placement
key.summary: Screen placement: top-left/top-center/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-center/bottom-right (bottom stacks upward)

key.name: monitor
key.summary: Monitor to show popups on ('primary', 'focused' = the one under the pointer, or a connector like DP-1)

key.name: font-family
key.summary: Font family ('' = system interface font)

key.name: summary-size-pt
key.summary: Title font size in pt (0 = derived from system font)

key.name: body-size-pt
key.summary: Body font size in pt (0 = derived from system font)

key.name: title-body-gap-px
key.summary: Vertical gap between the title and the body (px)

key.name: theme-mode
key.summary: Color mode: auto (follow system), light, or dark

key.name: background-color
key.summary: Background color override (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa); '' = theme

key.name: foreground-color
key.summary: Text color override (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa); '' = theme

key.name: history-size
key.summary: Notifications kept in history

key.name: suppress-on-fullscreen
key.summary: Suppress popups while a fullscreen window is focused

key.name: gtk-takeover
key.summary: Also take over org.gtk.Notifications (native-GTK apps)

key.name: a11y-announce
key.summary: Announce notifications to screen readers (AT-SPI / Orca)
